name: Probability Theory
author: pugmire

kolmogorov_additivity.proof: P(A union B)=P(A)+P(B) for disjoint A,B

shannon_entropy.proof: H=-sum(p*log2(p)) is the unique measure satisfying continuity, maximality, and additivity.

explicit_failures: Cannot handle conditioning on measure-zero events without extension
notes: Same carrier [0,1] as fuzzy but different gradient family (measure vs Lukasiewicz).
